gen-dafont-starborn-gf-quando: Dreamy, spaced-out, faintly haunted, all at once. Starborn earns its place big and brief, while Quando's sparse spacing and tall middle zone give the serif text a bookish, traditional footing.
gen-dafont-starborn-plus-jakarta-sans: Ghostly letters drifting far apart. Plus Jakarta Sans keeps its curve endings well apart too, drawn in one monoline stroke, so a long run of text moves smoothly beneath Starborn's thick, dark lowercase.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-almendra: Stencilia is structural and striking, with gaps at its curve ends. Almendra brings a dignified classic serif body with deep lowercase midsections, and that firm-meets-bookish tension is the pair's real hook.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-bree-serif: Bree Serif reads literary and refined, its outsized lowercase proportions giving every line a generous, friendly bulk beneath the heading. Stencilia's structural gaps then punch through above it.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-port-lligat-slab: Stencilia stands out for the spacious gaps it leaves at curve terminals, giving the headline a structural, striking build. And Port Lligat Slab keeps extended reading literary and traditional, its wide porthole counters letting each line breathe.
gen-dafont-stencilia-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans reads modern and precise, a single monoline stroke with its curve endings kept well apart from the stems. Under Stencilia's striking headings, paragraphs run smooth and unhurried.
gen-dafont-stencilia-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk comes in geometric and level-headed. Stencilia's striking, gap-toothed shapes meet a body drawn as one constant-width ribbon, and that shift from loud to measured is the draw.
gen-dafont-stentiga-fs-plein: Spread-out, refined, and quietly luxurious, in one glance. Stentiga's open tracking and thick crossbars lead, while Plein's clear channels into each round letter keep the text reliable and clean underneath.
gen-dafont-stentiga-fs-spline-sans: Refined spacing defines Stentiga, with tracking opened wide and openings like a door left ajar. Spline Sans matches it with identical-weight strokes and wide gaps at curve ends, and that friendly, approachable ease is the pair's best trait.
gen-dafont-visitor-fs-plein: Visitor is pure nostalgic digital, with gaping mouths on its e. Plein is happiest at a generous body size, its clear channels into round letters keeping the text reliable.
